content: Gradio error/alert pattern: gr.Error must be raised ('raise gr.Error(message)') — halts execution and shows red banner. gr.Warning() and gr.Info() are called directly (non-halting). Button state management: return gr.update(interactive=False, value='Processing…') as one of the outputs from the handler function, bound in outputs list. Or chain .click(disable_fn, outputs=[btn]).then(main_fn, inputs=[...], outputs=[...]).then(enable_fn, outputs=[btn]). asyncio.run() works in sync Gradio handler because Gradio calls sync handlers in thread pools (no running event loop in thread). Python 3.12 asyncio.run() is the correct API. async def handlers are preferred (bypass threadpool, better concurrency) but sync + asyncio.run() works correctly.
